generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per attached KW-3 document

To qualify for the award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26) Mandating satisfactory completion (at least 90% Contractor value) as a prime contractor for at least one similar nature of similar Plant & Machinery erection works to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work of Rs.32.22 Lakhs

To qualify for the award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26) achieved in at least Two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of refrigeration engineering construction works only) of Rs. 64.44 Lakhs.

itemList.description: Kirloskar KC X -4 ammonia compressor with Flywheel, Motor Pulley and Gauges box
50 HP Siemens make TEFC Sq. cage induction motor suitable for operation on 400/440 volts, 3 phase, 50 cycles, 1500 rpm, AC Supply, IE-3 with roller bearing.
Condenser 12 Nos, liquid and gas header material, pump, pipeline
2 HP condenser water circulating pumps set with a suitable motor for operation on 400/440 volts, 3 phase, 50 cycles
Ammonia receiver of joint size is 18” dia X 5” long with liquid inlet and Outlet, safety, purge, charging & gauge Glass connection
Refrigeration trunk coils made from 32 mm1.25 C class black heavy pipe, containing suitable Rft of pipe length with header and accumulator of suitable Size with expansion valve
18 dia X 48 long vertical brine agitators, with V-belts and motor pulley
Set of MS heavy-duty C-class Ammonia pipe & fittings for the complete plant as per our design and based on a close hook-up of the equipment, Bolt and Paint Materials
Ice can size 8” X 22” X 48” made out of TATA sheet 16 gauge Galvanised iron sheet of each 100 Kg (220 LBS)Capacity
First charge of ammonia gas for the commissioning of the ice plant
An ice crusher suitable for a 100 Kg Block.
10 HP Crompton Greaves make motor for crusher with a suitable motor for operation on 400/440 volts, 3 Phase, 50 cycles, 1500 rpm, IE-2
Wooden frame work and wooden covers using Jambal/Bent Teak wok for supporting ice cans.
